name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a complete QAOA MaxC
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit (depth p=2) for edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (0, 5), (1, 3), (1, 5), (2, 4), (2, 5), (3, 4), (4, 5)], including manual cost/mixer construction, classical optimization, and sampling of the final state. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
